full_page.content:
1947, December 3rd
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
December 3rd 1947.
Mr. J .J. O'Donnell. Hargi.11, Texas. Bles'd be God in all His designs!
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary, Huntington, Ind.
December 3rd 1947.
God bless you J & J. from Fr. Guardian and all
Many Thanks for your thoughtful kindness, with six crates of fruit that in perfect condition arrived Today. - about which, later. You are fortunate to be in the sunny South-west these days, - rain and snow in a sort of contention and gale from the N.E. urging them on. May the Lord bless your care-taker Johnson and family. I feel that I sort of know them too. Best regards. We pray for them too.
... Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
